fatal warnings:
    - "WARNING: '([^']*)' reference target not found:((?!.rst).)*$"
    - "WARNING: Include file '([^']*)' not found or reading it failed"
    - "WARNING: Non-consecutive header level"
    - "WARNING: Document headings start at"
    - "WARNING: Parsing of expression failed"

# A regexp of errors we currently allow so that we can fail on new errors,
# but resolve these at a later date. Please do not add new items to this list
# unless they are part of the existing known issues.
allowed_errors: []

max_num_warnings: 20

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Accepted tb-doc only applies allowed_errors and fatal warnings checks when their keys exist and their disable flags are false. The current config explicitly supplies both and says not to add newly encountered failures as known exceptions; it also limits total warnings. Missing keys in a historical config are not equivalent to a clean build or permission to suppress new errors. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Distinguish optional docs config keys from disabling error checks
